summary: Social worker and multicultural victim advocate with over five years of experience providing case management, crisis intervention, and client advocacy for survivors of domestic violence, human trafficking, and related harms. Brings bilingual Spanish/English capability and experience counseling diverse clients, including Latino communities and immigrants, on safety planning, court accompaniment, victim compensation, and legal navigation. Has trained professionals on immigration and multicultural service delivery and developed community programming for immigrant youth. Holds specialized certifications in trauma-informed advocacy, U-visa processes, and criminal injuries compensation, and has interest in transitioning toward human resources generalist work.
